reviews.title: Unwarranted censorship
reviews.text:
I commented on some of their news stories, explaining that ‘some guy’ on YouTube is not an expert opinion on world football.
Displaying someone’s opinion as news is wrong, whatever way you look at it and for me pointing that out, i was stopped from commenting on their so called news section entirely. 
Shame, it’s a good app but apparently my opinions on their flawed news section was not wanted. I therefore spent months looking through alternative apps to this one, you know, an app that doesn’t sensor my views outright, even though they are fully warranted. For those of you interested; Flashscore app is where I ended up, it tends not to sensor legitimate comments questioning the accuracy of their ‘news’ and doesn’t just post YouTube opinions in a news  section .
